decks.notes: This deck focuses on quickly getting powerful creatures onto the battlefield by casting Goryo's Vengeance and using instant reanimation spells like Ephemerate and Faithful Mending. The main combo involves bringing back big threats like Griselbrand or Atraxa, Grand Unifier to dominate the game. Thoughtseize and Force of Negation help protect the combo pieces, while Prismatic Ending and Solitude deal with opposing threats. Other cards like Fallaji Archaeologist and Psychic Frog provide additional value and control elements to the deck. The goal is to assemble the combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with strong creatures and instant reanimation.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells. The key strategy is to efficiently use low-cost creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Guide of Souls to apply pressure early in the game, while using burn spells like Galvanic Discharge and Goblin Bombardment to finish off the opponent. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Static Prison and Mana Tithe to control the opponent's board state and protect your own creatures. Overall, the goal is to win the game quickly through a combination of creature-based aggression and direct damage.

This deck focuses on utilizing a variety of aggressive creature cards, along with Leylines and Leyline Binding to control the battlefield. The deck also includes burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Tribal Flames to deal direct damage to the opponent. Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Scion of Draco provide strong creatures to apply pressure on the opponent. Quantum Riddler and Stubborn Denial offer protection and disruption, while Arena of Glory provides additional support for your creatures. Overall, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a mix of aggression and control elements.

The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly using the Urza lands and Expedition Map to search for them. It also utilizes powerful Eldrazi creatures like Thought-Knot Seer and Emrakul, along with planeswalkers like Ugin and Karn, to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The inclusion of Trinisphere and Chalice of the Void helps to limit the opponent's options, while cards like Devourer of Destiny and Sire of Seven Deaths provide additional threats. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and disruption spells.

This deck focuses on assembling a powerful combo involving Broodscale Bloodchief and various support cards to generate massive amounts of value and overwhelm the opponent. It utilizes a mix of creatures, spells, and lands to ramp up quickly and establish a dominant board presence. The key strategy is to efficiently deploy threats and disrupt the opponent's game plan while setting up the combo for a game-ending finish. By carefully managing resources and sequencing plays, the deck aims to outmaneuver and outpace the opponent to secure victory.

The deck focuses on controlling the opponent's board with counterspells, removal, and hand disruption. It aims to outvalue the opponent with powerful creatures and card advantage engines. The deck utilizes a mix of removal spells, counterspells, and disruptive creatures to control the game and protect its key threats. The main win condition is through powerful creatures like Ketramose, the New Dawn and Solitude, while also disrupting the opponent's game plan with Thoughtseize and Relic of Progenitus. The deck aims to grind out the opponent and win through attrition and resource denial.

The deck focuses on quickly reanimating powerful creatures like Griselbrand using cards like Goryo's Vengeance and Solitude. Atraxa, Grand Unifier helps to control the board and protect your combo pieces. The deck also utilizes counterspells like Force of Negation and disruption like Thoughtseize to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Faithful Mending and Ephemerate provide card advantage and help to set up your combos. The deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats and control elements.

The deck focuses on assembling a variety of creatures with different abilities to generate value and disrupt the opponent's game plan. It utilizes creature tutor cards like Chord of Calling and Green Sun's Zenith to search for specific creatures needed for the situation. The deck also includes cards like Delighted Halfling and Yawgmoth, Thran Physician to generate card advantage and control the board. The toolbox approach allows for flexibility in adjusting to different matchups and provides a versatile game plan.

This deck focuses on quickly assembling the Allosaurus Combo by utilizing cards like Allosaurus Rider, Eldritch Evolution, and Neoform to bring out big creatures like Ghalta, Stampede Tyrant and Griselbrand. The deck also includes ways to protect the combo with Pact of Negation and Veil of Summer. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Xenagos, God of Revels and Ureni, the Song Unending to provide additional support and finish off opponents quickly. Overall, the key strategy is to combo off as quickly as possible while disrupting opponents with counters and protection spells.

The deck revolves around the synergy between Amulet of Vigor and bounce lands, allowing for explosive mana generation and rapid deployment of big threats like Primeval Titan. The key strategy is to ramp quickly using cards like Arboreal Grazer and Urza's Saga, while also having access to powerful combo finishers like Scapeshift and Boseiju, Who Endures to overwhelm the opponent. The deck also includes toolbox cards like Green Sun's Zenith and Tolaria West to search for specific answers or threats as needed, making it a versatile and potent combo deck in the Modern format.

The deck focuses on using instant reanimation spells like Goryo's Vengeance and Ephemerate to bring powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Atraxa, Grand Unifier onto the battlefield quickly. It also includes ways to protect these creatures with cards like Solitude and Force of Negation, as well as disruption spells like Thoughtseize. The deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats, while also having answers to common threats in the format.

This deck focuses on generating value through sacrificing creatures with Blade of the Bloodchief and triggering abilities with Glaring Fleshraker. The combo potential lies in using Kozilek's Command and Malevolent Rumble to control the board while ramping into powerful threats like Emrakul, the Promised End. Urza's Saga helps to find key pieces, while Eldrazi Temple allows for fast mana generation. The deck also includes disruption elements like Pithing Needle and Soul-Guide Lantern to disrupt the opponent's strategy. Overall, the deck aims to control the game until it can assemble its combo pieces for a decisive victory.

This Dredge combo deck focuses on filling your graveyard with cards that can be used to recur powerful creatures like Arclight Phoenix and fuel spell-casting abilities. Using cards like Faithless Looting and Burning Inquiry, you can quickly dump cards into your graveyard while also gaining value from cards like Creeping Chill. By strategically filling your graveyard and using cards like Life from the Loam to recycle key lands, you can overwhelm your opponent with a high-powered board presence and out-value them in the late game.

This deck focuses on quickly reanimating powerful creatures, such as Griselbrand, using cards like Goryo's Vengeance and Faithful Mending. It also utilizes instant spells like Ephemerate and Solitude to control the board and protect your combo pieces. Thoughtseize is included to disrupt your opponent's game plan. Quantum Riddler helps filter your draws and provides card advantage. Teferi, Time Raveler is used to bounce problematic permanents and protect your combo. Overall, the deck aims to assemble its combo pieces quickly and efficiently to overwhelm the opponent.

The deck focuses on assembling a powerful creature combo using cards like Allosaurus Rider, Neoform, and Eldritch Evolution to quickly bring out massive threats like Griselbrand, Ghalta, and Elesh Norn. It also includes support cards like Veil of Summer and Pact of Negation to protect the combo from disruption. The deck aims to ramp up mana quickly with cards like Bridgeworks Battle and Planar Genesis to set up explosive turns and overwhelm the opponent with big creatures and game-ending combos.

This deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Atraxa, then bringing them back onto the battlefield using cards like Goryo's Vengeance. The deck also utilizes cards like Faithful Mending and Ephemerate to draw cards and protect the combo pieces. Quantum Riddler provides additional card advantage and control options, while cards like Thoughtseize and Prismatic Ending help to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to win the game quickly by reanimating big threats and overwhelming the opponent before they can respond.
